## Verified institutional/organization sources

- **Lewis & Clark — San Diego representative:** San Diego County is assigned to **Qwadere “Q” Lovell**, *Senior Assistant Dean of Admissions, Southern California*. His published direct contact information is **qlovell@lclark.edu**, **503-713-1203**, Frank Manor House, **615 S. Palatine Hill Road, Portland, OR 97219**. [Lewis & Clark profile](https://college.lclark.edu/live/profiles/13789-qwadere-q-lovell)

- **Hunter College Silberman MSW, Fall 2026:** The **application deadline is March 1** and the **supporting-document deadline is March 15**. The Fall table applies to the two-year full-time, Bank Street dual-degree, advanced-standing, one-year residency, and DOHMH Mental Health Scholarship residency MSW options. [Silberman deadlines](https://sssw.hunter.cuny.edu/admissions/deadlines/)

- **Indiana University Kokomo — graduate offerings:** IU Kokomo’s official graduate-programs page says its offerings span master’s degrees, graduate certificates, and postbaccalaureate work. The graduate programs listed through its official program pages are:
  - **Master’s degrees:** Master of Business Administration; M.S. in Management; M.S. in Strategic Finance; Master of Public Management; M.A. in Mental Health Counseling; M.S. in Nursing; online M.A. in English; online M.A. in History; online Master of Liberal Studies; and online M.S. in Criminal Justice and Public Safety.
  - **Graduate certificates:** Business Analytics; Leadership; Public Management; Health Management; Composition Studies; Language and Literature; Literature; History; Political Science; Communication Studies; Mathematics; and related Regional Online Collaborative certificate options, including Biology.
  - **Postbaccalaureate certificates:** Accounting and Business Fundamentals.
  - **Official source:** [IU Kokomo Graduate Programs](https://kokomo.iu.edu/graduate-programs/index.html). (Several of the online options are presented on departmental/online-program pages rather than in the landing page’s visible summary.)

- **UCSF glioblastoma studies in Northern California — currently accepting new patients:**
  1. **Anti-EGFRvIII synNotch Receptor Induced Anti-EphA2/IL-13Ralpha2 CAR (E-SYNC) T Cells** — UCSF labels the status **“accepting new patients”**; location: **UCSF, San Francisco, CA 94143**. This is a Phase 1 study for EGFRvIII-positive glioblastoma. [UCSF study, NCT06186401](https://clinicaltrials.ucsf.edu/trial/NCT06186401)
  2. **DOC1021 Dendritic Cell Immunotherapy for Treatment of Newly Diagnosed Adult Glioblastoma (GBM)** — status **“accepting new patients”**; locations include **UCSF, San Francisco, CA 94143** (and City of Hope, Duarte). This is a Phase 2 study in newly diagnosed IDH-wild-type GBM. [UCSF study, NCT06805305](https://clinicaltrials.ucsf.edu/trial/NCT06805305)

  UCSF’s glioblastoma listing currently summarizes its displayed open studies as “open to eligible people”; the individual records above provide the more specific current status, “accepting new patients.” [UCSF glioblastoma listing](https://clinicaltrials.ucsf.edu/glioblastoma)

- **ORU student activities/student-experience lead:** ORU publishes **Augustine Mendoza, Director of Student Experience**, **augiemendoza@oru.edu**. The cabinet page does not publish a direct telephone number for him. ORU’s published general campus contact is **(918) 495-6161**, 7777 South Lewis Ave., Tulsa, OK 74171. [ORU SA Executive Team](https://oru.edu/current-students/my-campus-life/student-association/cabinet/index.php)

- **EDF Energy graduate-programme information / salary-review wording:** EDF’s official *Graduate and Placement Brochure* says: **“You will receive annual increases, plus annual bonus, relocation allowance and other flexible benefits.”** Thus it does communicate annual salary increases for new hires, but it does **not** use the precise phrase “salary review” in that sentence. [EDF Early Careers / Graduate and Placement Brochure (PDF)](https://www.edfenergy.com/sites/default/files/graduate_and_placement_brochure_2023_2024.pdf)

*Clinical-trial availability and eligibility can change; UCSF’s “accepting new patients” label is the status shown on the cited study records.*
